text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S conquered the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). The crowd was overwhelmed by her 
sheer strength. Yet to her, this victory 
was only the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She announces her desire to aim for the 
Arima Kinen. Her Trainer encourages her, 
saying that with the true strength she has 
gained, she is more than capable of 
running a powerful race there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Symboli Kris S is challenged to a 
dance battle by Tap Dance City, who is 
active in the Senior Class, and the two 
face off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S took note of the frenzy Tap 
Dance City whipped up with her dancing. 
That fiery heat, she felt, resembled 
Tanino Gimlet's.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curious about how Symboli Kris S intended 
to achieve her "revolution," Tap Dance 
City challenged her to a showdown at the 
Arima Kinen.
